title: Need assistances with characters creations for my game.

posts.author: Adventurer021
posts.body:

posts.author: Avery
posts.body:
Trying to make a game with hyper specific resources that do not exist yet at no cost is honestly just expecting someone else to foot the bill by giving their time. There are more people wishing for free resources made for them then people willing to do that at a whim - especially for someone with no reputation and not knowing if the game will be good or if there would even ever be at least a playable demo
People tend to help out a lot, but the more you are asking for, the less likely it gets. I could see someone helping you for example if your chapter 1 requiring those characters was already complete with placeholder characters, so you'd just have to swap them out.

posts.author: Adventurer021
posts.body: What are other ways to obtaining these characters? I don't know anything when it comes to using pixel art for the characters and thought that maybe someone in the community could help me (Again, this is the first time that I do a post to gain help.)

posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body: The other way is to find an existing sprite that's close to what you want and edit/frankenstein several sprites together. Just make sure the sprites have edit permissions.

posts.author: Zia_
posts.body:
If you're willing to learn pixel art, you could check out tutorial videos and do them on your own. They won't turn out perfect, but you'll learn during the process, and you have good placeholders while working on your game. Eventually, you have the skills to improve your charsets.
Other than that you can check the available resources to find somewhat close and edit them. It's easier - especially as a beginner, to edit stuff instead of doing it from scratch.
Or - if you're positive, you'll actually finish the project and it's worth it, you could hire someone for money.

posts.author: Adventurer021

posts.author: Zia_

If you're going for the RTP style, there's a dog in the "nature" file. Their snout should fit well for that "Loona" character after some edits.
Also, there's a kitsune and and a werewolf in the "monster" set.
